observations: Photo 0: a blue foot-mounted industrial gear reducer, cycloidal or planetary style, lying on sandy ground in sunlight.
A solid output shaft protrudes on the right with surface rust and wear marks; the input end on the left is a large flange.
No electric motor is attached or visible in the photo; the input flange appears open or capped.
A small black nameplate is fixed on the housing but its text is not legible at this resolution.
Paint looks fresh and even, including over bolt heads, which may be a repaint rather than original finish.
A lifting eye and bolts are visible; a black cable lies on the ground nearby, not clearly connected to the unit.
Dealer watermark 'CHIDONBEST INDUSTRIAL' over the image.

read_from: photo 0 housing shape, output shaft and input flange
